nodes.description: Scope the assessment: which site, which date/shift, and whether all three tracks are in scope (safety, materials carbon, schedule) or only some. Matches the `/workflow construction-full` fan-out shape.

Collect the SiteSense inputs: temperature, humidity, windSpeed, workerCount, recentIncidents (`/site-safety` input contract). Wind and weather readings are the inputs most likely to be stale — check the reading's timestamp, not just its presence.

A required reading is missing, stale, or out of plausible range. This is the path the current parallel fan-out has no state for: re-poll the sensor, fall back to the nearest weather station, or mark that track degraded. A degraded track must be labelled degraded in the final report — a safety score computed from a stale wind reading is worse than no score.
Run SiteSense (`/site-safety`, cli: `run sitesense --input`). Produces safety score 0-100, weather risk level, worker capacity adjustment, and EN 13001 crane operation warnings.

Safety score below 60 — the `/site-safety` skill's own documented critical threshold, which calls for flagging and immediate suggested actions. Surface this before any other track's findings: a crane-risk warning must not be buried under a carbon table.

Run Material Oracle (`/carbon-analysis`, cli: `run material-oracle --input`) for embodied carbon per EN 15978 across stages A1-A3, A4, A5, B, C, D. Produces total kgCO2e, per-stage breakdown, and low-carbon alternatives.

Total embodied carbon exceeds the project's budget — the `/carbon-analysis` skill's documented trigger for suggesting material substitutions. Record the substitution options rather than silently reporting the overage.

Schedule-genius track: does the safety-adjusted worker capacity (from ASSESS_SAFETY) still meet the programme, and do any material substitutions (from CARBON_BUDGET_EXCEEDED) change lead times? This is the cross-track dependency the parallel fan-out cannot express today — it runs all three at once and merges, so a capacity cut never reaches the schedule.

Unified report: safety score + crane warnings, embodied carbon + alternatives, schedule impact, and an explicit list of any degraded tracks (from STALE_INPUT_RECOVERY). Read-only deliverable — no site instruction is issued by this graph, so no RED-zone gate applies.
Terminal for this run — assessment abandoned (site inaccessible, sensors down, shift cancelled). Re-enterable next shift.
